name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Tree.sum_paths_prod
title: Ordered products distribute over all 2^d paths (hashing a read-once branching program's truth table)
statement: In any semiring, for d factors f_i(false) + f_i(true), the ordered product prod_{i<d} (f_i(false) + f_i(true)) equals the sum over all alpha in {0,1}^d of the ordered products prod_{i<d} f_i(alpha_i). With f_i(b) = D_b (x) M_{i,b} (Kronecker products, by the mixed-product rule) this is Lemma 6 of Abram-Malavolta-Roy, Tree Encodings I (ePrint 2026/741): the Merkle root sum_alpha (prod_i D_{alpha_i}) e_0 BP(alpha) of the 2^d-entry truth table of a read-once matrix branching program is prod_i (D_0 (x) M_{i,0} + D_1 (x) M_{i,1}) e_0, computable in polynomial time.
